claims.assertion: Athena Swaruu claims the Federation controls Earth's regional money flows according to population and geoengineering agendas.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)
claims.qualifiers: She says the Federation frames hardship as an incarnational challenge.

claims.assertion: Athena says authorities can constrain productive regions through inflation, restrictions, or other economic interventions.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)
claims.qualifiers: She argues markets do not operate independently of higher-level control.

claims.assertion: Athena alleges Centaurian operatives receive Federation funding and act as human-appearing agents in political and other institutions.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)
claims.qualifiers: She says identities are uncertain and declines to name suspected individuals.

review_flags: The transcript advances unverified claims of hidden control and infiltration; these are attributed to Athena.
coverage_gaps: Athena's related claim that higher-level elections are predetermined
